openrsyncVersion:
openrsync: protocol version 29
rsync version 2.6.9 compatible
fullHelp:
Options:
 -r, --recursive    recurse into directories
 -a, --archive      archive mode
 -n, --dry-run      show what would happen
 --                end of options
mixedHelp:
--recursive       recurse into directories
 --archive         (NOT SUPPORTED)
 --dry-run-extra   similar spelling
 --                stop parsing options
deceptiveHelp:
Usage: rsync [-ran] source destination
 -r                recurse
 --no-recursive    disable recursion
 --recursive-extra extended recursion
 prose mentions --archive and --dry-run
 --other           description mentions --recursive
 --                a long option follows
conflictingHelpErr:
--recursive       not supported
 --archive         archive mode
 --dry-run         not supported on this platform
